he.text: מַה־נֹּאמַר לְפָנֶיךָ יוֹשֵׁב מָרוֹם וּמַה־נְּסַפֵּר לְפָנֶיךָ שׁוֹכֵן שְׁחָקִים׃ מַה־נֹּאמַר מַה־נְּדַבֵּר וּמַה־נִּצְטַדָּק · הֵן בַּעֲבָדָיו לֹא יַאֲמִין וּבְמַלְאָכָיו יָשִׂים תָּהֳלָה׃

en.text: What shall we say in thy presence, O thou, who dwellest on high? What shall we declare unto thee, who residest above the skies? What shall we say, what shall we speak, how shall we clear ourselves? Behold he putteth no trust in his servants, and his angels are charged with folly.
